    The realization functor F : C_J ⥤ K(Q) (Proposition 2.3, Step 2) #

    The category C_J is modelled as the additive envelope of the one-point extension of the intervals with index in J. The functor F sends an interval to (the image in K(Q) of) its resolution, X to L[-1], and u ∈ D_i = C_J(X, A i) to the class xLin u.
